seo.siteTitle: Supreme Engineering Services | MEP Contracting & Consultancy Indore
seo.defaultDescription: Supreme Engineering Services (SES) is an MEP contracting and consultancy firm in Indore specializing in HVAC, Fire Fighting & Safety, Electrical, Cold Rooms, Piping, and Solar energy.

services.name: Fire & Safety
services.summary: Detection, suppression, sprinkler networks, and code-compliant fire protection systems.

services.name: HVAC
services.summary: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning engineered for load, airflow, and energy efficiency.

services.name: Cold Rooms & Storage
services.summary: Refrigeration engineering and cold-chain infrastructure for storage and processing facilities.

services.name: Fabrication
services.summary: Custom ducting, structural steel, and metal fabrication built to project-specific drawings.

services.name: Water Purification
services.summary: RO and filtration systems for domestic and industrial use, sized and installed to demand.

services.name: Electrical Works
services.summary: Electrical panel installation, load planning, and wiring for commercial and industrial sites.

services.name: Solar
services.summary: Solar panel installation and system design for domestic and industrial power needs.

services.name: IT — Software & Applications
services.summary: Custom software and applications for internal operations and client-facing tools.

about.heading: Built on-site, not in a boardroom.
about.summary: Supreme Engineering Services was founded to close the gap between design intent and what actually gets installed. We run every project as a single accountable scope — no finger-pointing between trades.

principles.title: Single point of accountability
principles.description: One team owns design, procurement, and installation across every discipline we deliver.

principles.title: Compliance-first documentation
principles.description: Drawings, calculations, and commissioning reports handed over at every milestone, not just at closeout.

principles.title: In-house fabrication
principles.description: Ducting and structural work built to spec in-house, cutting lead time and third-party error.

principles.title: Post-handover support
principles.description: Maintenance and AMC coverage after commissioning, so systems keep performing after we leave site.

team.name: Irshad Ali
team.bio: Irshad Ali is a Electrical engineer with over 30 years of experience in MEP contracting and consultancy. He has led projects across India, specializing in fire safety, HVAC, Electricals, Cold Rooms & Storage and more.

team.name: Sarfaraz Ali
team.bio: Sarfaraz Ali is an expert in water purification systems, with a focus on RO and filtration technologies. He has successfully implemented water treatment solutions for both domestic and industrial clients.

team.name: Md. Zubair Khan
team.bio: Md. Zubair Khan is a civil engineer with extensive experience in structural design and construction management. He ensures that all civil works meet the highest standards of quality and compliance.

team.name: Meer Bilal Ali
team.bio: Meer Bilal Ali specializes in solar energy systems and design engineering. He has designed and implemented solar solutions for various commercial and industrial projects.

team.name: Meer Azmaan Ali
team.bio: Meer Azmaan Ali is a software engineer responsible for digital operations and developing custom Production grade applications to streamline project management and client interactions.
